A depth-write experiment for TubeField was rejected because conservative proxy envelopes wrote incorrect depths and cut holes in valid tube evidence; TubeField remains a depthless candidate envelope until a real multi-candidate reservoir stores color and travel together.
source: TubeField bloom/fog visual QA

lesson: TubeField blackbody ramp sampling was correct on X, but the old single-tube proof material branch treated high emission scale plus material.y near 1 as an exact red/orange proof tube and bypassed the ramp. Spectrum TubeFields now sample the ramp from saturated normalized amplitude on X and use amplitude squared for emission intensity; the exact proof branch is only reachable through an explicit negative tubeData.w sentinel. The high-end blue is expected to survive mostly as a cool fringe after ACES/SE bloom because the blackbody asset's right edge is pale blue and peak emission tonemaps toward white.
source: Mimir spectrum dashboard blackbody ramp QA

lesson: TubeField no longer owns final scene contribution through a private blend/K-buffer path. D3D12 now separates scene-candidate MRTs from canonical scene MRTs, clears a shared two-slot-per-pixel field reservoir UAV, lets TubeField pixel evaluation inject opaque SDF candidates with color/travel/metadata/control/reservoir-guide, then runs a fullscreen field-reservoir resolve that writes the canonical scene lanes before temporal resolve, bloom, and presentation. Legacy/direct contributors currently enter that resolve as the scene-candidate input candidate; future cuts should move them to explicit claim injection too.
source: field reservoir ownership cut

lesson: The first TubeField ReSTIR cut replaces per-fragment reservoir scatter locks with pixel-owned compute reservoirs. TubeField expansion now emits reusable segment records with baked geometry/material endpoints; D3D12 bins active segments into screen tiles once per frame, streams a small fixed candidate set into a per-pixel initial reservoir, combines previous-frame reservoirs through reprojection, performs spatial neighbor reuse, and exports the selected sample into the shared field-reservoir candidate buffer for canonical scene resolve. Runtime shader compilation and Mimir synthetic spectrum execution passed; frame timing settles around the vsync band after ramp-up, but local window capture was unreliable and should not be treated as visual QA evidence.
source: TubeField ReSTIR ownership rebuild

lesson: Reservoir history update and reuse moved out of the presentation pixel shader into a shared D3D12 compute pass. The pass reads canonical scene lanes, shared field candidate rows, and ping-ponged structured history rows; writes the next four history rows per pixel; and emits a resolved HDR field texture consumed by bloom and final presentation. The presentation shader no longer writes reservoir history, so it cannot become a hidden TAA owner. Fensalir and Mimir builds passed, the Mimir spectrum upload smoke passed, and a synthetic spectrum headless capture rendered through the compute-owned reservoir path.
source: user selected full structured-buffer reservoir path

lesson: TubeField ReSTIR reuse no longer imports neighbor-pixel coverage directly. Temporal and spatial reuse now re-evaluate a shifted reservoir's selected segment at the receiving pixel before combination, and TubeField exports the four best deterministic current pixel candidates into the shared field-reservoir rows. This removes the wrong stochastic authority from opaque primary visibility, though the spectrum dashboard still reads visually busy because it draws many age-column tubes through generated segment proxies. Verified with Fensalir/Mimir builds, --mimir-spectrum-upload-smoke, and headless capture artifacts/runtime/reservoir-deterministic-top4-spectrum.png.

lesson: The many-spline TubeField quality path stays on cheap segmented proxies. Segment continuity now fixes data ownership inside that model: every generated proxy vertex carries the same start/end radius pair, and the compute segment packet stores true start/end radii plus feather/alpha separately. ReSTIR candidate evaluation and tile binning now use the true end radius instead of silently reusing the start radius, reducing join disagreement without spline-wide SDF evaluation. Verified with Fensalir/Mimir builds, --mimir-spectrum-upload-smoke, and headless capture artifacts/runtime/tubefield-cheap-continuity-spectrum.png.

lesson: TubeField candidate authority has moved from generated segment packets to rolling-buffer column packets. D3D12TubeFieldExpandCS now emits one GPU-resident TubeFieldColumn per logical spectrum column and zeroes generated-mesh draw args; ReSTIR tile binning and candidate evaluation sample the source buffer directly as Catmull-Rom spline SDF evidence, with ramp sampling bound in the ReSTIR root signature. Debug builds compile TubeField ReSTIR shaders with optimization enabled because SkipOptimization can make the compiler unroll the column evaluator into failure. Verified with Mimir.App build and headless synthetic spectrum capture artifacts/runtime/mimir-column-packet-final-headless.png at about 60 FPS after warmup.

lesson: The first column-packet TubeField ReSTIR pass still skipped visible splines because tile admission kept only one depth candidate per 4x4 spatial lane. That made overlapping spectrum columns evict each other before the pixel reservoir could choose. TubeField tile lanes now keep four sorted depth candidates per spatial lane, and initial/export passes evaluate those depth lanes for the receiving pixel. Verified with Mimir.App headless capture artifacts/runtime/mimir-column-depth4-headless.png; visual fill improves substantially while headless timing remains around 60 FPS after warmup.
source: user observed skipped splines in column-packet spectrum capture

note: Cut the TubeField-local compute ReSTIR/tile-bin path. Authorized TubeField path is compute-generated conservative segment proxy geometry, raster proxy SDF evaluation, and pixel-shader candidate injection into the shared field reservoir; shared reservoir/history remains the only final visibility authority.

TubeField proxy rasterization now only schedules pixels. The pixel shader computes analytic ray intersections against generated tube frustum/cap segments in world space, and reservoir history carries previous candidates across subpixel current-frame misses instead of clearing them. Remaining dense-line grain belongs to shared reservoir reconstruction quality, not TubeField raymarch/proxy ownership.

Reservoir reconstruction now follows the TSR-grounded support/rejection cut for TubeField: carried history is latent-only unless current evidence validates it, FieldReservoirCandidate rows include a motion lane, TubeField writes previous UV/travel from rolling-buffer offset motion, physical rolling-column identity prevents age-column cross-validation, TubeField samples without motion cannot use generic camera-only history, and tube validation bypasses raw RGB clamp with a gated low-support history search/spatial fallback.

Reservoir debug modes 13-15 now inspect the compute-owned reservoir result: invalidation/rejection state, history/sample age plus confidence, and explicit motion support. Debug output is written from D3D12ReservoirHistoryUpdateCS into the resolved reservoir texture so diagnostics observe the layer that actually owns final TubeField reconstruction.

Explicit-motion reservoir candidates now track represented sample count separately from history age in the motion lane. TubeField history confidence can ramp from accumulated validated evidence, and reservoir debug mode 14 exposes history age, represented count, and confidence.

Hard-rebuilt the live field reservoir into a shared seven-lane FieldReservoirSample ABI with proposal and stats lanes. Rows now mean current, temporal, spatial, and final; TubeField proxy rasterization emits one-sample RIS proposals into row 0; scene/SDF MRT evidence normalizes into the same proposal shape; temporal reuse validates previous row-3 final reservoirs; spatial reuse validates neighboring current reservoirs; old nearest-travel-minus-coverage slot replacement is cut from TubeField injection and final resolve. Proposal policy now survives field evidence lowering/backend packets and invalid zero/NaN target/sourcePdf is rejected before backend emission. Verified with Aquarium.Engine.Tests, dotnet build Fensalir.sln, headless dev reload, and Mimir --mimir-spectrum-upload-smoke.

Completed the reservoir diagnostics cut after the rebuild: render debug options 13-15 now name row-3 reservoir rejection, stats, and proposal views; invalid final reservoirs render as unsupported instead of accepted green/proposal mass; CPU RIS tests now pin sourcePdf, represented count, merge probability, selected target, weight sum, candidate count, and contribution weight. Verified with Aquarium.Engine.Tests, Aquarium.Engine.Fractal.Tests, dotnet build Fensalir.sln, headless dev reload, Mimir --mimir-spectrum-upload-smoke, and captures artifacts/fensalir-captures/reservoir-rebuild-fixed-mode13.png, mode14.png, and mode15.png.

Row-3 final reservoir color now applies the RIS contribution weight via fieldReservoirResolvedColor; intermediate current-frame proposal MRTs remain raw to avoid double-weighting before temporal/spatial reuse. Reservoir rejection debug now distinguishes unsupported final rows, temporal rejection, disocclusion/no previous support, spatial reuse, missing explicit motion, occlusion, and field-id mismatch.
